paragraphs.text:
Despite  superficial  appearances,  these  creatures  are  closer  to 
humans than apes. You use your anthropological training to 
mollify them and avert potential hostility.

Attempt an Anthropology roll: if you succeed, go to 349; if you fail, 
go to 376.
